_format: Keyed by fixture file name. A field value { "accept": [a, b] } means either answer is right (ambiguous article). relatedSymbols is compared as a set. earnings.figures lists KEY figures only (not every one): each must be in the output with the same metric + value, and a period/basis/kind/perShare that matches (an array = any of these values; a key left out = not scored). Figures added in M2 (2026-11-25), DRAFT.

01-ies-q4-results.notes: Q4 + full-year release: Q4 figures come first. GAAP diluted $4.50 vs adjusted $4.07. FY EPS $13.24 must not be used. A 'two-for-one stock split ... August 2026' footnote is a passing mention, not splits. time: published 12:45 UTC = 7:45 ET, own press release → bmo (D11).

02-t3-defense-q3-results.notes: Net income positive, basic EPS +$5.05, but 'a loss of $30.80 per diluted share': D12 diluted over basic → −30.80. Q2 2026 figures are 'previous'. time: 14:10 UTC = 9:10 ET → bmo.

03-johnson-outdoors-date.notes: Date announcement: 'before market open'. The 11:00 a.m. ET is the conference call, not the release time.

04-qnb-dividend.notes: 'declared … on November 24' has no year in that sentence → yearInferred (or the dateline 'Nov. 24, 2026'). No ex-dividend date stated.

05-hp-results-dividend.notes: Full-year figures come FIRST ($2.62 GAAP EPS, $60.5B revenue); Q4 is $0.84 GAAP / $0.83 non-GAAP, $16.0B. The $0.30 dividend is last quarter's (previous). fiscalDateEnding only in a table header ('Three months ended | October 31, 2026'). time: 21:15 UTC = 16:15 ET → amc.

06-seneca-forward-split.notes: 'five-for-one forward stock split'. Effective on filing, Nov 16; split-adjusted trading from Nov 17.

07-bullfrog-reverse-split.notes: No explicit effective date; split-adjusted trading begins Nov 30.

08-ready-capital-reverse-split.notes: Ratio in words: 'one-for-ten'. Effective 5:00 p.m. ET Dec 7; split-adjusted trading Dec 8.

09-inlif-consolidation.notes: Called both 'share consolidation' and '1-for-16 reverse stock split'.

10-windward-ipo-pricing.notes: Swiss company, Nasdaq listing (no suffix). Also a concurrent private placement (not the IPO).

11-vitacig-ipo-filing.notes: 2014 release (fixture only). A spin-off via Form S-1; the shares are paid out as a share dividend, so 'dividends' is arguable. Only the parent's ticker (OTCQB:MCIG) is written.

12-cmb-tech-q3-results.notes: IFRS reporter; dates written '30 September 2026'. Revenue is only in a table 'in thousands' (802,932) → our D37 rule refuses a bare number: expected MISS. Distribution = $0.21 dividend + $0.44 share premium. Ex-date differs by exchange (Euronext Dec 8, NYSE Dec 9). Three listings: NYSE, Euronext Brussels (.BR), Oslo (.OL, unverified suffix).

13-infrastructure-split-corp-distributio.notes: Adversarial: 'Split Corp.' is a fund name, NOT a stock split. Values only in a table row 'November 30, 2026 | December 15, 2026 | $0.15'. TSX → .TO.

14-transcontinental-date.notes: Canadian date announcement, no ticker written in the text (symbol must be null). The 2027 calendar and the Dec 10 call are distractors.

15-fervo-ipo-class-action.notes: Adversarial: the IPO is mentioned many times, but the subject is a class action (a law firm's notice), not an IPO action.

16-flipkart-ceo-ipo-mention.notes: IPO only in passing ('amid IPO uncertainty'); subject is the CEO stepping down.

17-anthropic-ipo-priced-news.notes: News story (not a press release). First trading day only as 'on Thursday' (relative) → null. marketCap: 'valued at roughly $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis'.

18-nvidia-revenue-news.notes: News story of actual results. 'third quarter of fiscal 2027'. Date only as 'on Tuesday' (relative) → null. $108B was the company's own guidance, not an analyst estimate. No ticker written.

19-anthropic-ipo-risks-opinion.notes: Opinion piece on the risks of buying the IPO. Arguable: it states 'shares expected to start trading on November 19th' (ipos/expected). Drafted as others because the subject is the risks, not an IPO action.
